name: nadavai
description: Nadav Cohen's Claude Code environment as one installable bundle: OMC orchestration, official tool plugins, ADHD output shaping, personal skills and hooks.

plugins.name: nadavai
plugins.description: Everything in one install: oh-my-claudecode, context7, LSPs, Playwright, Supabase, Chrome DevTools, Cloudflare, skill-creator, i-have-adhd, Bright Data research MCP, the UI/UX and product layer (Impeccable, intent, interfaces, ux-design, product-innovation, PostHog), plus Nadav's skills and repo-sync hooks.

plugins.name: agent-plus
plugins.description: Desktop app only: a right-side Agents pane with a + that lists Codex, Grok, Antigravity, Gemini, OpenCode and Claude and opens the pick in a Terminal-panel tab, and every saved Claude and Codex account with its 5h/7d usage, blocks and a Switch button, through ccswap. Does nothing in a terminal such as Orca.
